hooks.name: Check Environment
hooks.description: Creates .venv and installs dependencies if they are missing, then reports a one-line kiro-env: status. Tries python3, python, then py -3 so it works on macOS, Linux, and Windows 11. Always exits 0; problems are reported as kiro-env: PROBLEM lines.

action.command: python3 setup_env.py --hook || python setup_env.py --hook || py -3 setup_env.py --hook || echo kiro-env: PROBLEM - no Python interpreter was found on PATH. KIRO - tell the user to install Python from https://www.python.org/downloads/ - on Windows they must check Add python.exe to PATH during install - then reopen Kiro. Do not try to build or deploy apps until then.

hooks.name: Load Steering Files
hooks.description: Loads all steering files with inclusion: auto at session start.

action.prompt: Activate the following steering files using the disclose_context tool: api-reference, coding-standards, meta, web-standards, workflow
